announcement.title_cn: 2025年半年度权益分派实施公告

extraction.title_en: Implementation Announcement on the 2025 Interim Equity Distribution','stock_code_placeholder'
extraction.summary_en: Ping An Bank will pay an interim 2025 cash dividend of RMB 2.36 per 10 shares (tax inclusive), totalling RMB 4.58 billion, with no bonus shares or capital reserve conversion, as approved by the 42nd meeting of the 12th Board on 22 August 2025. The distribution is based on 19,405,918,198 shares outstanding at 30 June 2025. The share registration date is 14 October 2025 and the ex-dividend date is 15 October 2025. Certain holders, including Hong Kong and QFII investors and restricted-share individuals, receive RMB 2.124 per 10 shares after withholding, and tax on restricted shares held 1 year or less is subject to top-up payments.
